title: AuthUi::proxy_list_open bool is the sign-in proxy box's open stage, reset by hand in follow_auth(Ready) and close_proxy_list_box
trigger: Open the proxy list from the sign-in screen (pane Connecting), then the account reaches Ready; or the flag is left true while pane_mode flips Connecting -> Ready -> Connecting
effect: No bug today: proxy_list_box_shown() also gates on pane_mode()==Connecting and follow_auth clears the flag on Ready, but the box stage is a bool plus a derived pane check kept in step by hand
fix: fold into the existing DialogKind box host (open_box/close) or an enum on AuthUi (Closed/ProxyList) cleared by the Farewell/auth transition in one place
